messages:
sylvia: Quick question — as we roll out the new runtime flags (route-level sampling + quota overrides), how do we want to surface sampling in the console and telemetry?
raj: We currently only record final decision (served/blocked). Need sampling visibility to debug why a request was sampled differently.
alice: +1. Operators frequently ask "did the sampling gate hit?" during rollouts.
tomas: Two parts: 1) API: attach sampling metadata to trace/span. 2) Console: show sampled cohort % next to flag.
sylvia: Thinking about fields: sampling.strategy, sampling.seed, sampling.rate, sampling.reason. Would that be enough?
raj: Add sampling.key (what hash we use: user_id, session_id, route). Determinism is important for replay.
maya: UX note: we should avoid exposing raw seeds. Console should show human-friendly explanation: "user hashing on user_id -> included".
ops-bot: FYI: when sampling changes we need to preserve audit trail. Suggest emitting an immutable event to telemetry-index.
alice: On the API side, can we add an optional "sampling_info" to the runtime config decision proto? Minimal change: optional message with strings.
tomas: Pseudo-proto suggestion:
```
message SamplingInfo {
  string key = 1;
  double rate = 2;
  string strategy = 3; // e.g., percentage, consistent_hash
  string reason = 4; // e.g., rollout=cohortA, emergency-debug
}
message FlagDecision {
  bool enabled = 1;
  SamplingInfo sampling = 2;
}
```
raj: That looks fine. Need to be careful about size — we attach to every decision in high-traffic routes. Make fields compact.
sylvia: Agree. Keep strings short and optional. Telemetry pipeline will enrich later.
maya: Console mock: show "Sampling: 10% (user_id hash) — cohort A" inline on flag row, clickable for example users.
alice: Also add a "sampled_count" metric per flag and per-route bucket for dashboards. That helps SLO math.
ops-bot: Create alert if sampled_count deviates >30% from expected given traffic for 5m.
raj: Rollout plan idea: staged increase of sampling.rate with shadowing turned on. Use snapshot mode: sample decisions recorded but not enforced for 24h.
sylvia: Can we implement "dry-run sampling" at runtime? i.e., record decision.sampling but do not alter routing/quota decisions until enabled.
tomas: Yes. Add a runtime toggle: sampling.dry_run = true. That avoids config churn while we validate.
alice: API change required: consumers must opt-in to read sampling_info. Backward compat: field optional so old services ignore it.
maya: Need migration doc for integrations (metrics, splunk, jaeger). I'll draft one.
raj: One more: hashing algorithm must be explicit (murmur3_32 etc.) and versioned so we can reason about past decisions.
sylvia: Good catch — include sampling.algo and sampling.version.
ops-bot: created ticket INF-4923 to add sampling_info proto + telemetry events and console mock link: https://go/redwood/INF-4923
deploy-bot: Deploy preview for proto change scheduled in canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC.
alice: Tests: unit test for deterministic bucketing + integ test verifying sampled_count metrics emitted.
tomas: Also add small e2e: generate 10k synthetic users to assert sampled fraction within 1.5x expected for 95% CI.
maya: UX followups: show last 24h sample distribution heatmap and quick filter to view sampled example requests.
raj: Ops question: what about privacy? If key=user_id, we must avoid leaking raw PII in telemetry. Mask or hash before export.
sylvia: Policy: telemetry exports must never contain raw user identifiers. Use HMAC with service key or only export bucket id.
ops-bot: noted. Adding "telemetry_masking" checklist to INF-4923.
alice: Are we comfortable with storing sampling.seed in trace? It's useful for debug but might be sensitive. Option: store truncated seed or versioned id.
maya: UX compromise: show deterministic info in console only if user has "debugger" role.
sylvia: Action items: 1) raj + tomas: proto spec + perf estimate. 2) alice: metric names + alerts. 3) maya: console mock & role gating. 4) ops-bot: telemetry privacy checklist. 5) deploy-bot: canary schedule.
raj: I'll PR the proto today. Expect perf number: +1-2% CPU on decision path (rough).
tomas: I'll run perf bench against 200k req/sec profile.
maya: I'll sketch console and share in #devex later.
ops-bot: Will follow up in INF-4923 with required audit fields.
sylvia: Thanks everyone. If no objections I want this on the next rollout sprint.
alice: No objections from me. :thumbsup:
raj: SGTM.
maya: SGTM.
ops-bot: Thread closed after action items created.
